Container.Name: ShelfSaver
Container.Overview: Watches your video library folders and converts worthwhile files to H.265 on the GPU, checking each result before it replaces the original. Intel Quick Sync (pass /dev/dri) or NVIDIA NVENC (add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters).

Config.Name: Settings (config)
Config.Description: Settings, history and the login. Keep this on the cache/appdata pool.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: The folder that holds your libraries (mount the parent so every library is inside it). Converted files replace the originals here.

Config.Name: Scratch (work folder)
Config.Description: Optional fast disk for the work-in-progress files, e.g. a cache pool path. Must be on the same kind of storage you are happy to fill temporarily.

Config.Name: Intel GPU (Quick Sync)
Config.Description: Intel Quick Sync. Remove this device if you use NVIDIA.

Config.Name: Encoder
Config.Description: qsv = Intel Quick Sync, nvenc = NVIDIA.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the container runs as. 99 is Unraid's 'nobody'. Converted files get the original file's owner either way.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the container runs as. 100 is Unraid's 'users'.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions mask for files the container creates itself (not for converted files, which copy the original's).

Config.Name: NVIDIA devices
Config.Description: NVIDIA only: which GPU to use ('all' or the GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin).
